## Aggregate Gladiator Robot (CR 18)

**XP** 153,600  
CE Medium construct (robot)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** all-around vision (areas with cameras), blindsight 60 ft., darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, superior optics; Perception +16  


**Defense**


**AC** 34, touch 16, flat-footed 28 (+1 dodge, +5 Dex, +18 natural)  
**hp** 161 (22d10+40)  
**Fort** +14, **Ref** +17, **Will** +14  
**Defensive Abilities** adaptive defense programming, hardness 15; **Immune** construct traits; **Resist** electricity 30, fire 30  
**Weaknesses** overclocked targeting, vulnerable to critical hits, vulnerable to electricity  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft.  
**Melee** adamantine chainsaw +30 (4d12+7/18–20), adamantine buzz saw +29 (2d12+7)  
**Ranged** hypersonic rifle (range 150 ft.) +27 (2d12/×3 plus stunned 1 round, DC 30 Fort negates)  
**Special Attacks** boosted charge 2/day (full attack at end of charge), combined arms (full attack with all melee and ranged attacks)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 25, **Dex** 20, Con—, **Int** 18, **Wis** 14, **Cha** 18  
**Base Atk** +22; **CMB** +29; **CMD** 45  
**Feats** Cleave, Combat Reflexes, Deep Focus, Following Step, Lunge, [Point-Blank Shot](../../rules/feats/point-blank-shot.md), Psionic Meditation, Psionic Shot, Speed of Thought, Step Up, Step Up and Strike, Vital Strike, Wild Talent, [Weapon Focus (chainsaw)](../../rules/feats/weapon-focus.md), [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Point-Blank Shot and Precise Shot are one feat, Point-Blank Shot; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Weapon Focus (chainsaw), Dodgility.*  
**Skills** Acrobatics +27 (+39 when jumping), Autohypnosis +16, Bluff +18, Disguise +18, Intimidate +26, Perform (oratory) +26, Sense Motive +24, Spellcraft +21  
**Languages** Abyssal, Aklo, Binary, Common, Draconic  
**SQ** flexible programming, integrated weaponry, work the crowd  


**Special Abilities**


**Adaptive Defensive Programming (Ex)** Three times per day as an immediate action, a gladiator robot can change one of its resistances to any other energy type for 1 minute.  

**Flexible Programming (Ex)** Ten times per day as an immediate action, a gladiator robot can gain the benefit of any feat for which it qualifies but does not have. Each feat remains in effect for 1 minute. In addition, it counts its racial Hit Dice as fighter levels for the purpose of qualifying for feats. If it has levels in fighter, these Hit Dice stack with these levels.  

**Integrated Weaponry (Ex)** A gladiator robot’s weapons cannot be disarmed, removed, or sundered.  

**Overclocked Targeting (Ex)** When the gladiator suffers a critical hit, it attempts a Fortitude save (DC 20), instead of being staggered or stunned like other robots. On a success, it attacks a randomly determined target within 60 feet on its next turn. On a failed save, it attacks random targets for 1d4+1 rounds.  

**Superior Optics (Ex)** Gladiator robots see invisible creatures or objects as if they were visible.  

**Work the Crowd (Ex)** As a swift action after reducing a foe to 0 hit points or otherwise incapacitating it while a crowd watches, a gladiator robot can attempt a DC 20 Perform (gladiator) check. If it succeeds, the gladiator robot recovers 4d10 hit points, up to its maximum hit points.
